_comment: MVP-004 curated entry/exit edges. Hand-picked from scripts/list_entry_exit_candidates.py's output (docs/plans/004-multimodal-city.plan.md Phase 1) — real, named, distinct arterial roads only; the many other geometric candidates were minor residential dead-ends where the MVP-002 coverage outline happened to clip through a small street, not real city gateways. Fewer than the originally-hoped ~10: Helsingborgsvägen and Kullavägen (both real roads visible in docs/architecture/map_plain.gif) don't appear as candidates at all, meaning the outline doesn't clip through them at a dead-end in this network.
